validationScope: CSS var() references to --forma-color-* plus reserved internal color-related prefixes; other Forma APIs are governed by their own contracts.

compatibility.policy: Validate with the contract shipped by the pinned Forma package version.

fallbackPolicy.rationale: A literal may support standalone layer loading, but it must not invent a color or make an unsupported Forma name appear valid.

internalVariables.policy: Implementation variables are not a consumer compatibility contract.
